summary: Phase 4 (Persistent Chat Memory + Shared AI Context / RAG) — full backend + frontend regression. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass (6 existing in test_iteration30_memory_rag.py + 6 new in test_iteration30_memory_rag_extended.py covering backfill idempotency, manual /memory/save from existing approval, branch creates child thread with parent_thread_id + version kind='branch', search retrieval round-trip, /memory-sources endpoint shape, archive→restore card lifecycle). Frontend: /memory page renders with backfilled items (60 items across 2 type groups — Decision + Research), search input filters items by query, Backfill button works, New card dialog creates a Decision card and it persists after reload. AI Composer (@ai compose) shows the 4 memory-mode pills (none/chat/project/workspace) with data-testid memory-mode-{key}; clicking workspace activates it (visual purple border). Save-to-memory dropdown item exists in MessageBubble with data-testid save-memory-{id}. ThreadActions component (Continue/Branch/Versions) is wired into AIComparison panel — rendered when a thread is expanded inline in chat (not on the /ai listing page, which is correct per design). Demo workspace data intact; no production data mutated.

issues: A11y warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — non-blocking but should add DialogDescription for screen readers.

action_items: (Optional/Non-blocking) Add <DialogDescription> to MemoryNewCardDialog, ContinueThreadDialog, BranchThreadDialog, VersionsDialog to silence the aria-describedby a11y warning in console.

(Optional) Consider exposing a data-testid on the AIComparison container's expanded state so e2e tests can drill into a thread to reach the ThreadActions toolbar without inspecting AI message bubbles.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/memory.py L142–168 (create_card) uses FastAPI query params for title/content/memory_type — clients must send these as ?title=...&content=... query string (not JSON body). This is a deliberate choice in the implementation and works, but is inconsistent with the rest of the API which uses Pydantic JSON bodies. Recommend converting to a Pydantic model for consistency. Verified working in tests via params=.

backend/routes/memory.py L84–89 — _fetch_source_content is best-effort and silently returns (None, None) for unknown source_types; save_memory then raises a 400. That's correct behavior. However, consider logging the unknown source_type for observability when client passes a typo.
backend/routes/ai_threads.py L148 — `final_answer` is fetched a SECOND time from db after _finalize_research; cleaner would be to return final_answer from _finalize_research directly. Cosmetic.

backend/routes/ai_threads.py L266–274 (branch) — only logs version_number=1 for the new branched thread; if the user then continues the branch, version 2 will be recorded. The branch row's `final_answer` is correctly captured. Good.

Frontend MemoryNewCardDialog: title + content are required to enable Save button via disabled={!title.trim() || !content.trim()} — good. No XSS concern since content goes into Mongo text-indexed search_text and is rendered via React (escaped).

Frontend AIComposer memory-mode pills: default is 'chat' as specified; pressing a pill correctly toggles state. Inactive pills use hover:border-purple-400/40 which made my naive selector match 'border-purple-400' for inactive too — recommend distinguishing active vs inactive with a clearly different class (e.g., border-purple-400 (active) vs border-white/10 (inactive)). It's already implemented this way in code (line 96 of ThreadActions / line 172 of AIComposer); my test had a false-positive. Not a code issue.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 ships clean. To regress: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration30_memory_rag.py /app/backend/tests/test_iteration30_memory_rag_extended.py -v` (12 tests, ~30s). For UI: /memory page is the main surface; AIComposer memory-mode pills are tested via opening any group chat and clicking [data-testid=open-ai-composer]. Continue/Branch/Versions toolbar appears INSIDE expanded AIComparison panels in chat (not on /ai list page) — to reach them, find a chat message of type 'ai_question' with metadata.thread_id and click into it; the AIComparison renders ThreadActions at the bottom. Demo workspace currently has ~60 memory items (mostly Decision + Research types from backfill). Backfill is idempotent — safe to call multiple times.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Phase 4 implementation is solid. All 12 backend endpoints work correctly (CRUD + search + timeline + backfill + memory-mode-aware AI research + continue/branch/versions/memory-sources). Auto-memory hooks on approve/call-summary/voice-transcribe are wired in via record_memory() — verified indirectly via the backfill counts increasing on first run, then plateauing on second run (idempotent test). Frontend integrations pass: token-bearer auth works, memory CRUD round-trips correctly, dialog and form components render with proper data-testids. The only minor finding is an a11y console warning about DialogDescription which doesn't affect functionality.
